metadata.title: On the eccentricity evolution of massive black hole binaries in stellar backgrounds

notes: No eligible stars identified. The paper studies generic three-body scattering experiments between model massive black hole binaries and unbound stellar intruders; it does not identify any individual star as a Galactic unbound candidate, nor does it follow up a specific star previously identified as one. Sgr A* is discussed as a massive black hole, not as a star.
